title: aidd records
description: The record types' format (schemas/records.json), and in `$defs/record` one record: a file in `.git/aidd/records/<yyyy>/<mm>/<id>.json`, which `aidd records add` writes. A record is history, never a person's yes and never evidence.

types.description: Each record type by its name, such as `decision`.

description.description: What a record of this type records.

data.description: The JSON Schema of the record's `data`.

$defs.description: The parts the types' schemas share.

record.description: One record: an envelope of seven fields, and the facts of its type in `data`.

id.description: The UTC time to the millisecond, then 8 random hex characters: unique, sorted by time, and the file's name.

type.description: The record's type, a key of schemas/records.json's `types`, which sets the shape of `data`.

at.description: When the record was written, in UTC.

by.description: Who wrote the record: `agent:<harness>/<model>`, as a commit's `Assisted-by`, or `person:<git name>`.

written_with.description: What wrote the record: `cli`, the command `aidd records add`, or `mcp`, the MCP `record` tool. The tool runs with no prompt, so aidd never fills a decision's `answer.by` from the git name there.

subject.description: The work item the record belongs to, such as SPEC-4.

data.description: The facts of the record's type.

schema_version.description: The version of this output's shape.

records.description: The records, newest first. Each is a record as written, of a type this aidd knows or not.

pulled.description: The ids of the records listed that `aidd records pull` added: another's text, never this clone's own account.

unreadable.description: The files in the records folder that do not read as a record, which were skipped.
